name: Out Of This Earth
author: mcidclan
description: Description : Welcome to 'Out Of This Earth,' an exciting puzzle adventure game in 3d. This version includes two chapters and it's playable on PSP or PPSSPP. Objective : Take control of the car and set out on a mission to collect all the scattered stars across the map. To achieve this goal, you must strategically solve a variety of puzzles. Your journey begins with Chapter 1, and upon successfully collecting all the scattered stars and following the tracks revealed in the sand, you will unlock access to the next chapter. In Chapter 2, gathering the stars becomes a more intricate task as you encounter thoughtful challenges that demand careful consideration. Completing Chapter 2 unlocks a surprising way to journey between both chapters. Controls : Use the Left, Right, Cross, and Triangle buttons to maneuver the car. As you progress through your adventure, you may also need to utilize the Circle, Square buttons, and/or the Left & Right Triggers to overcome challenges and uncover secrets. Embark on an immersive and challenging puzzle adventure, and enjoy the thrill of solving each chapter as you progress further into the game!
